description: Download free, ATS-friendly developer cover letter templates tailored for software internships, entry-level engineers, and remote tech jobs.

image.alt: Free Tech Cover Letter Template Layout

body:
A great cover letter shouldn't be an autobiography. In the tech industry, a high-impact cover letter is a concise, 1-page pitch highlighting your technical projects, problem-solving mindset, and alignment with the company's product challenges.

## 1. The Core Structure of a Modern Developer Cover Letter

- Header: Your Contact Information, GitHub Link, Portfolio URL, and Recruiter / Hiring Team Name.
- Salutation: Addressed to the specific Engineering Manager or Hiring Lead (or 'Dear [Company Name] Engineering Team').
- Opening: Why you are applying to this specific team, referencing recent company milestones or open-source initiatives.
- Core Pitch: 2 to 3 bullet points highlighting technical wins from your personal projects or previous internships.
- Closing: A confident call to action inviting a discussion about their technical roadmap.

## 2. Downloadable Template for Engineering Internships

```text
Dear [Hiring Manager Name or Team],

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Software Engineering Intern role at [Company Name]. As a Computer Science student with hands-on experience building full-stack applications in [Tech Stack 1] and [Tech Stack 2], I have closely followed [Company Name]'s work on [Specific Product Feature], and I would love to contribute to your engineering team this term.

During my recent project, [Project Name], I:
- Architected a [Type of System] using [Technologies], reducing [Metric] by [Percentage].
- Built automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Docker, achieving 90%+ test coverage.

I am eager to bring my rapid learning ability and technical ownership to [Company Name]. You can view my open-source code at [GitHub Link] and live demos at [Portfolio Link].

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
```
